  • Constructor Details

    • Principal

      private Principal(String credential, String subject, String tenant, Set<String> roles, String issuer, boolean authenticated)
      Creates a principal.
      Parameters:
      credential - raw credential, or null for anonymous callers
      subject - stable subject identifier, must not be null
      tenant - tenant or project scope, must not be null
      roles - granted roles, must not be null
      issuer - token issuer, or null when not applicable
      authenticated - whether the transport authenticated the caller

  • Method Details

    • anonymous

      public static McpRequestContext.Principal anonymous()
      Returns the shared anonymous principal.
      Returns:
      an unauthenticated principal with no credential

    • ofApiKey

      public static McpRequestContext.Principal ofApiKey(String apiKey)
      Creates an authenticated principal from an API key presented at the transport layer.
      Parameters:
      apiKey - the API key, must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      a principal carrying the API key as its credential

    • ofClaims

      public static McpRequestContext.Principal ofClaims(String subject, String tenant, Set<String> roles, String issuer)
      Creates an authenticated principal from validated OIDC/OAuth token claims.
      Parameters:
      subject - the token subject claim, must not be null or empty
      tenant - the tenant or project scope, may be null
      roles - granted roles, may be null
      issuer - the token issuer claim, may be null
      Returns:
      a principal carrying the subject as its credential

      Returns a short non-reversible hint of a credential for audit records.

      Returns:
      the first characters of the credential, safe to log
